name: Galaxy Tab S8

Body.Weight: Tab S8: 503 g (Wi-Fi), 507 g (5G), Tab S8+: 567 g (Wi-Fi), 572 g (5G), Tab S8 Ultra: 726 g (Wi-Fi), 728 g (5G)

Platform.Operating system: Original: Android 12 with One UI 4.1, Current: Android 16 with One UI 8
Platform.CPU: Octa-core (1x3.00 GHz Cortex-X2 & 3x2.50 GHz Cortex-A710 & 4x1.80 GHz Cortex-A510)

Display.Display: Tab S8: 11.0 in TFT LCD, pixels, 16:10 aspect ratio (~274 ppi density), 120Hz refresh rate, Tab S8+: 12.4 in Super AMOLED, pixels, 16:10 aspect ratio (~266 ppi density), 120Hz refresh rate, Tab S8 Ultra: 14.6 in Super AMOLED, pixels, 16:10 aspect ratio (~240 ppi density), 120Hz refresh rate

Sound.Sound: Quad stereo loudspeakers tuned by AKG

Battery.Battery: Tab S8: 8000 mAh, Tab S8+: 10090 mAh, Tab S8 Ultra: 11200 mAh

Connectivity.Connectivity: USB Type-C 3.2, Wi-Fi 802.11 a/b/g/n/ac/ax, dual-band, Wi-Fi Direct, hotspot, Bluetooth 5.2, A2DP, LE
